# NewRecall Salon

> Salon CRM for follow-up dates (last visit + how many weeks the service usually lasts), Paystack billing, closed-app alerts, and the operator desk.

- [Overview](index.mdx): Product identity, stack, and what stays on the device
- [Setup](setup.mdx): Local Vite, Vercel, environment variables, PWA
- [The book](book.mdx): Routes, how clients are called back (interval, lead, status), follow-up, messages, settings, backup
- [Billing](billing.mdx): Paystack trial, entitlement, APIs
- [Alerts](alerts.mdx): Local notifications, Web Push, cron, what is uploaded
- [Operator desk](admin.mdx): `/admin`, cookie session, Paystack lists, repair, Redis notes
